gloss: limit amount, credit limit, maximum amount

definitions.gloss: limit amount, credit limit, maximum amount
definitions.explanation: The maximum monetary amount allowed for a transaction, loan, credit card, tax deduction, or other financial matter. Common in banking, insurance, and tax contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限度額|げんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the credit limit on my card.

examples.japanese: ⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限度額|げんどがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧200{万円|まんえん}です。
examples.english: The maximum deduction amount is two million yen per year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{融資|ゆうし}→融資：04775_yuushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限度額|げんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げて→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted the bank about whether the loan limit could be raised.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{限度|げんど}→限度：00063_gendo⟧ (limit) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount). Very common in financial and administrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {限度額|げんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the limit
- {限度額|げんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to raise the limit
- {限度額|げんどがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set a limit
- {控除|こうじょ}{限度額|げんどがく}: deduction limit
- ⟦{融資|ゆうし}→融資：04775_yuushi⟧{限度額|げんどがく}: loan limit
- {利用|りよう}{限度額|げんどがく}: usage limit (credit cards)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上限額|じょうげんがく}: upper limit amount — synonymous, slightly more general
- ⟦{限度|げんど}→限度：00063_gendo⟧: limit — the base word without the monetary nuance; can refer to any kind of limit
- ⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧: frame, quota — colloquial for credit limit or allocation (e.g., ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枠|わく}→枠：13100_waku⟧)
